label: Simplicity
summary: What to leave out: guards for impossible states, catches that cannot act, unused envelopes, shallow helpers, speculative options.
must_follow: Assign each invariant to one authoritative boundary; repeat a check downstream only when it protects a distinct local use, enforces a stronger invariant, receives independently supplied data, or defends an independently deployed public contract.

Check an envelope's success flag before reading its payload; validate the envelope's shape and the payload's field types only when the result comes from a separately deployed script or service without a documented contract, never for a procedure in the same file.

Do not check the column count, the column types or the presence of fields that your own query selects; check only what the database can vary: no rows, more rows than the code assumes, and NULL in a nullable column.

Check a context object's shape once, in the procedure that builds it or where it is reloaded from storage or parsed from text; procedures that receive it later in the same flow use its properties without re-checking them.
Catch an error only to roll back or finish work, to return a failure result a caller branches on, or to add context the error lacks; otherwise let it propagate to the boundary that owns it.
Return the plain value when callers only use the value; use a success/failure envelope only when a caller branches on the outcome, and add no result field that no caller reads.
Inline a local procedure that has one caller and hides less than its call costs to read; extract a procedure when it names a real step of the work or has a second caller.
In a banner or doc block, describe a failure result or an empty case only when the code produces one; do not add outcomes to fill the template.
Comments explain purpose, ownership, safety consequences, replay behavior, or a non-obvious ordering requirement; do not narrate assignments or restate syntax.
avoid: Do not check for a state the code already rules out: a parameter every caller passes, a type SSL or the producer guarantees, a value already checked upstream, or the result of a procedure in the same file.
Add no parameter, option, branch or result field for a need that no caller, requirement or task has stated.

elements.name: TRY
elements.summary: Starts a protected block that can transfer control to :CATCH, :FINALLY, or both when errors occur.

elements.name: CATCH
elements.summary: Handles errors raised in the immediately preceding :TRY block.

elements.name: LimsTypeEx
elements.summary: Returns the public SSL type name for a value.

elements.name: CreateUdObject
elements.summary: Creates a dynamic object or instantiates a user-defined class.

elements.name: DoProc
elements.summary: Calls a local or scripted procedure by name with an optional argument array.
